name: m4-gen-baseline-s9500-gsm8k-humaneval
command: bash -lc 'set -e; export DAN_SCALE_DIR=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/qz_stage_traj4096_v7/scale; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false; B=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222; export CKPT_DIR=$B/m2_baseline_triangle/m4loop_ext_endpoint_ckpt; export MODEL_DIR=$B/models/RWKV7-Goose-World3-2.9B-HF; export MODEL_KIND=birwkv_diffusion NGPUS=1 NUM_SHARDS=1 COMMIT_GROUP=4 COMMIT_ORDER=confidence MAX_NEW_TOKENS=512 PROBE_ONLY=0 SEED=42; TASK=math TASKS_FILE=$B/capability_eval_data/tasks/gsm8k_tasks.jsonl OUTDIR=$B/cap_eval_s9500_math CONDITIONS=iter16 bash $DAN_SCALE_DIR/qz/launch_capability_eval.sh; TASK=code SUITE=humaneval TASKS_FILE=$B/capability_eval_data/tasks/humaneval.jsonl OUTDIR=$B/cap_eval_s9500_code CONDITIONS=iter16 bash $DAN_SCALE_DIR/qz/launch_capability_eval.sh; echo ===GEN_BASELINE_DONE==='
description: v8 campaign: PRE-SFT generation baseline on the loop s9500 endpoint (m4loop_ext_endpoint_ckpt). This is the denominator for B4's kill rule -- "HE/GSM8K below the plain-model pre-SFT numbers => SFT not transferring" -- and per the v8 plan the plain model sat at 0.61% HE / 1.21% GSM8K pre-SFT, with b3-sft reaching 1.22%/0.68% at s500. Without this reading there is no defensible bar for the chat lane. Runs the canonical qz/launch_capability_eval.sh (TASK=math then code) with COMMIT_GROUP=4 PINNED -- the launcher defaults it to 0, the legacy multi-commit mode that CAUSES the repetition degeneracy -- and CONDITIONS=iter16 so the denoise step count matches the MC probes' --steps 16. Requires the vendored task files, which were MISSING and were rebuilt this session from HF (capability_eval_data/raw was absent; gsm8k_tasks.jsonl 1319 rows sha256 03d4d909, humaneval.jsonl 164 rows sha256 2e730932). 1x H100 (79fe954a), ~1-2h.
